name: Kevlar vest
text: Toughness 1 against guns and blades. Doesn't stack with other Toughness.

name: Tactical armor
text: Toughness 1 against everything, but Disadvantage on Vanish and climbing.

name: Powered armor
text: Toughness 2 against blunt, blades and guns. Unreliable: when you roll a Miss while wearing it, the GM can cut it out (out of power, a jammed joint, a short circuit, whatever fits the scene). While it is offline it gives no Toughness. Spend a Quick Action to get it running again, or it is repaired at Dawn. Doesn't stack with other Toughness.

name: Sidearm
text: A gun (Flow to shoot). Far range is at Disadvantage.

name: Long gun
text: A gun with no Far penalty. Being seen carrying one is +1 Heat.

name: Baton
text: Light melee: +1 Harm on a Strike at Impact 2 or better. Jabs with it have no -2 penalty.

name: Fighting sticks
text: Light melee: +1 Harm on a Strike at Impact 2 or better. Jabs with it have no -2 penalty.

name: Weighted gloves
text: Light melee: +1 Harm on a Strike at Impact 2 or better. Jabs with it have no -2 penalty.

name: Bat
text: Heavy melee: +1 Harm on any hit, but only on a Strike with Force (never a Jab, never Flow).

name: Pipe
text: Heavy melee: +1 Harm on any hit, but only on a Strike with Force (never a Jab, never Flow).

name: Crowbar
text: Heavy melee: +1 Harm on any hit, but only on a Strike with Force (never a Jab, never Flow).

name: Knife
text: Everyone has one. +1 Harm on Impact 2 or better against anyone without Toughness. Can be thrown at Near range. A backup: an attack uses one weapon, never two weapon bonuses.

name: Grapple line
text: Quick Action: move to any zone you can see, including High Ground.

name: Med kit
text: Once per fight, Full Action: you or an ally next to you clears one Harm box (Down becomes Wounded).

name: Night-vision goggles
text: Dark zones don't affect you.

name: Police scanner
text: Once per Night, Edge on a Patrol roll. You also hear the cops coming a round early.

name: Earpiece comms
text: You can Help allies in any zone.

name: Taser
text: Engaged, it is a Jab. Or fire its dart at Near range: a Full Action Strike with Flow, with no -2. On a hit, instead of Harm, a mook drops, and anyone else loses their next Quick Action (a named enemy has Disadvantage on their next roll instead: see Named enemies resist being shut down). Electricity, so it ignores Toughness. Two uses per fight.

name: Surveillance kit
text: A tracker tag, bugs and a parabolic mic. Listen through glass and walls from across the street, plant a bug, or tag someone. Once per Night, Edge on a lead roll that involves listening in, watching or following someone. If someone you tagged gets away, you know where they went: that is a new lead.

name: Smoke grenades
text: Quick Action: your zone or an adjacent one becomes Dark until the end of next round. Two per fight.

name: Flashbangs
text: Quick Action: roll Flow against the Guard of everyone in your zone or an adjacent one; everyone you beat has Disadvantage on their next roll. One per fight. Named enemies: see Named enemies resist being shut down.

name: Bolas or net launcher
text: Ranged, Near. On a hit, the target can't take their free move until they spend a Quick Action to get free (no roll).

name: Riot shield
text: +1 Guard. Take Cover works anywhere. Disadvantage on Vanish, and you can't use a long gun.

name: Lockpicks and bypass kit
text: Edge on getting through locked doors, alarms and safes.

name: Burner phones
text: Once per Night, use a contact-based ability (Plugs, Network, or calling in a contact with Drive) one extra time. Any clue it gives still counts toward the team's one no-roll clue per Night.

name: Bike or car
text: Edge on one lead roll per Night. In a chase, Edge on Flow.

name: Drone
text: Quick Action: see into any zone within Far range. The spot lasts until the start of your next turn. Allies attacking a target you've spotted get Edge, once per round. Breaks on any hit.

name: Bow
text: A bow or crossbow (Flow to shoot). No Far penalty, and +1 Harm on Impact 2 or better. Silent: unlike a gun, it adds no Heat on its own. Not a gun, so Toughness applies. Like a gun, it is at Disadvantage when you're engaged in melee.

name: Tossies
text: Ranged, Near. Flow to throw. A hit deals 1 Harm (Toughness applies). On Impact 2 or better the target drops what they're holding, so their weapon bonus is off until they spend a Quick Action to recover it. If they hold nothing, they lose their next Quick Action instead (a named enemy has Disadvantage on their next roll: see Named enemies resist being shut down). Three per fight.

name: Forensic kit
text: Once per case, spend a scene working a crime scene or an object and take 1 clue, no roll.

name: Hacking rig
text: Edge on Focus rolls against systems, cameras and records. Once per Night, take 1 clue from them with no roll. If it comes from police or city records, take +1 Heat.

name: Weighted lash
text: A light melee weapon on a cable: +1 Harm on a Strike at Impact 2 or better, and Jabs with it have no -2 penalty. Quick Action, Near range: pull an enemy to Engaged with you, or swing yourself to High Ground in your zone or the next one.

name: Trip mines and caltrops
text: Quick Action, two per fight, either kind. A mine: set it in your zone, and the next enemy to move in takes Impact 2, ignoring Toughness, and stops there. Caltrops: scatter them in a zone you're leaving, and until the end of next round any enemy who moves in stops there. In a chase, caltrops give anyone behind you Disadvantage on Flow rolls.

name: Scoped rifle
text: A long gun with a scope. Edge on attacks at Far range if you haven't moved this turn. Being seen carrying one is +1 Heat.

name: Rebreather
text: Gas, smoke and fumes don't affect you, a gas Hazard costs you no Harm, and you ignore flashbangs (built-in ear and eye protection).

name: Tranquilizer darts
text: Ranged, Near. On a hit, a mook goes down. A named enemy has Disadvantage on all rolls until the end of their next turn, and a second hit in the same fight costs them one turn (see Named enemies resist being shut down). Two per fight.

name: Restraints
text: Full Action: bind an enemy who is Down, surrendering or willing. They can't act until freed or the scene ends. A bound prisoner can be interrogated.

name: Disguise kit and voice changer
text: Take on a new identity for a scene. Edge on rolls to bluff or scare someone who doesn't know you. Once per Night, pass as someone else with no roll. If you're seen through, take +1 Heat.

name: Glider cape and climbing gloves
text: Falls of any height cost you nothing, hard climbs to High Ground need no roll, and you can drop into any zone below you as a free move.

name: Shotgun
text: A gun for close quarters (Flow to shoot). No Disadvantage when you're engaged in melee, but it can't hit at Far range. Being seen carrying one is +1 Heat.

name: Foam grenades
text: Quick Action, your zone or an adjacent one. Pick one: put out a fire or live-wire Hazard (the zone loses the tag), or seal one door or exit (breaking through is a Force roll against 13). Two per fight.

name: EMP charge and jammer
text: Quick Action, one per fight. Pick one. EMP, your zone or an adjacent one: lights, cameras and electronics there go dead, so the zone becomes Dark until the end of the fight, and drones, comms and powered armor in it stop working until their owner spends a Quick Action to reset them. Jam: phones, radios and wireless alarms in your zone and adjacent zones go dead for the scene, so nobody there can call for help, and a public fight there adds no Heat (gunfire still does). Either one hits your own gear and earpiece comms too.

name: Breaching charge
text: Full Action, no roll: blow through a door, wall or vehicle in your zone. It opens a path into an adjacent zone, or removes Cover from your zone. On an Objective step it doesn't finish the step, but that step's roll has Advantage. Loud: +1 Heat. One per Night.

name: Exo-frame
text: Hydraulic braces over your arms and legs. You can lift a car. Force attacks get +1 Harm on Impact 2 or better and ignore Toughness, and you can throw heavy objects at Near range. Unreliable: when you roll a Miss with Force while wearing it, the GM can lock it up. While it is locked it gives nothing, and you have Disadvantage on Flow. Spend a Quick Action to vent it, or it is repaired at Dawn. It can't be hidden, and you can't wear it with powered armor.

name: Arc projector
text: A shoulder rig or a gauntlet that throws lightning. A ranged attack with Focus at Near or Far, with no Far penalty: +1 Harm on Impact 2 or better, and it ignores Toughness (electricity). Disadvantage when you're engaged in melee. Loud: +1 Heat for each fight where you fire it. Unreliable: when you roll a Miss with it, the GM can overheat it. While it is overheated it does nothing. Spend a Quick Action to vent it, or it is repaired at Dawn.

name: Barrier projector
text: A hard-light or magnetic shield emitter. Quick Action: roll Focus against 13. On a hit, Toughness 2 until your next turn (Toughness 1 on Impact 1). Unreliable: when you roll a Miss with it, the GM can burn it out. Spend a Quick Action to restart it, or it is repaired at Dawn.
